findings.title: Current Q2 authority documents assert incompatible production CI-NEB states
evidence: RESULTS_INDEX.md:26 says ‘NEB not yet run’, while RESULTS_INDEX.md:32 says the PI-authorized q=0+q=+1 production pair ran and both legs converged.

The same index names results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/CHARGE_STATE_ANCHOR.md as authoritative at RESULTS_INDEX.md:28-29, but that file says at :4 that one required leg is missing and at :15-16 that q=0 is not delivered and comparison is impossible; results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/PRODUCTION_NEB_STATUS.md:1 instead says BOTH LEGS CONVERGED. Q0_NEB_GATE.md:112 additionally retains an unmarked pre-launch decision.

reproduce: rg -n 'NEB not yet run|both legs converged' RESULTS_INDEX.md && rg -n 'One of the two required legs is missing|q = 0 \(V_I⁰\) any relaxed quantity.*not delivered|charge-state comparison.*impossible' results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/CHARGE_STATE_ANCHOR.md && rg -n 'BOTH LEGS CONVERGED' results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/PRODUCTION_NEB_STATUS.md && rg -n 'full q=0 CI-NEB submission decision is now OPEN' results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_NEB_GATE.md

proposed_check: C-STATE-003 — discover every Q2 authority named by RESULTS_INDEX.md and require production-NEB state predicates (not-run/missing/pre-launch versus ran/converged) to have one normalized current state or an explicit HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED marker; a fixture retaining the present index/anchor/gate text must fail.

verified_closed_findings.verification_summary: At 89db467e, RESULTS_INDEX.md:32 uses the full results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/PRODUCTION_NEB_STATUS.md path, and PRODUCTION_NEB_STATUS.md:24 and :26 use q0_production/q0_verify_last.json and q1_production/CONVERGENCE_SUMMARY_q1.json. Each target exists; Tier-0 C-LINK-001 independently reports 393/393 path-shaped references resolved.
